description: Declared claims of the PLACEBO manuscript. Each maps to the receipt in a sealed evidence package that would support it. A claim with no receipt is not made in the paper. This file is the input to the generated claim-evidence matrix and to the adversarial-review campaign spec.

claims.text: On one frozen open-weight subject across two objective tool-agent settings, correct verifier feedback produced a task-level success gain clearing both the mismatched-report sham and the pooled two-replicate no-feedback condition.
The paired no-feedback branches established an admissible post-trigger resolution scale against which the co-primary estimates were judged.
A four-arm snapshot-paired protocol separating correct task-specific feedback from a mismatched report and from pooled no-feedback continuation, at a tool boundary inside a long-horizon trajectory.
A resampling-null resolution test that turns post-trigger continuation variation into an observed control distribution rather than an assumed zero.
Cross-setting application to repository repair and stateful tool/API work with objective endpoint graders.
A lineage-aware, arm-blind artifact and inference contract reusable by agent benchmark authors.
Preregistered verdicts, including negative and unresolved verdicts, fixed before execution.
REAL and SHAM packets have exactly equal subject-token length under the frozen tokenizer.
A blinded packet classifier could not separate REAL from SHAM above the registered detectability bound.
The arm allocation was drawn before any continuation existed and is reconstructible from the sealed allocation receipts.
The registered power requirement was met at the selected roster tier before the schedule seed was revealed.
The analyst held no arm labels before the hash-gated single-use unblind ceremony.
This is not a claim that placebo-controlled feedback evaluation is novel; placebo, shape-matched, and compute-matched controls are prior art.
This is not a claim that verification helps every model or scaffold, nor an identification of a human expert verifier's effect.
This is not a claim that sham feedback is semantically inert, nor an identification of packet form alone.
